name: Mac (over SSH, or this Mac from omni)

settings.label: Username
settings.help: The account you sign in as on that computer, the same name you would type after ssh. Run whoami in a terminal on it to see it.

settings.label: SSH private key
settings.help:
A private key that computer accepts for that account. It stays on this phone. Make one on a computer with ssh-keygen -t ed25519, add the .pub line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the target, then paste the private file here, from its BEGIN line to its END line.
On a Mac, also turn on System Settings, General, Sharing, Remote Login.
